QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] The Secrets of Magatia
QuestInfo.1: Thanks to #t4031737#, #t4161032# can now be read the way it was meant to be... The hidden message pertains to the #bhistory behind the creation of #m261000000##k. #p2020005# told me to visit him after finding out all the truth behind the note...
QuestInfo.2: #m261000000#... With the secrets behind the town of alchemy about to be unveiled, I needed to see someone that is aware of its history... which means only one person. Alcaster.

0.0: Here, it's done. All the hidden text is visible. Let's see what's in this note...wait, this is... It's about #m261000000#... Do you know who wrote this?
0.1: I see, so you do... #m261000000#... This note is about the #bstory behind the creation of #m261000000##k... the truth that has never been made public, until now. I wonder how you managed to get a hold of this note...
0.2: Alas, no secret will stay hidden forever. The fact that you have this note means that you are the most qualified to handle this. I am sure the heads of the two societies will not be pleased with this, but... here you go, please take this note.

yes.0: Once you find out the whole truth on this matter, please come back and see me.

no.0: If you are too afraid to face the truth, then I suppose that's alright.

1.0: ...you're here. Did you read the note from top to bottom?
